text:
Alex: Heads-up — found a wrapped KMS blob in partner webhook logs (partner.example.com payload) that looks like a staging Vault backup. URL: https://partner-logs.example.com/ingest/evt/abc123 — path hints at /staging/secrets/. SEC-2026-307 opened. Need rotation + RBAC tighten ASAP.

Maya: ack. Is the blob decrypted anywhere on partner side? Any evidence of plaintext?

Alex: haven't seen plaintext, only wrapped blob. It references KMS key projects/redwood-kms/locations/us/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/wrap-staging. We gave cross-project decrypt to partner-sa@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com earlier.

Jamal: pulling audit logs now. @eng-infra-bot can you fetch KMS IAM binding history for that key and the Vault audit logs for /staging/* for the last 72h?

eng-infra-bot: fetching... results in 30s

security-bot: auto-alert: potential exfiltration event detected (anomalous outbound webhook to partner domain). Created ticket SEC-2026-307.

eng-infra-bot: KMS IAM history: partner-sa got roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on 2026-03-18T03:12Z via PR #748. Vault audit: 3 reads of /staging/db-creds on 2026-03-18 between 03:13-03:15Z from service-account: infra-runner@redwood. No plaintext writes to external.

Maya: good to know. Proposed plan: 1) revoke partner SA decrypt permission 2) create new key version / rewrap existing ciphertext 3) rotate affected Vault secrets 4) update partner integration for new wrapped blobs 5) forward partner webhook audit to SIEM.

Alex: agree. Who can revoke IAM? Jamal?

Jamal: I can remove the binding now. Running: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding wrap-staging --location=us --keyring=partners --member='serviceAccount:partner-sa@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter'`. Will also create a new key version and rewrap.

Sally: (from partner) we rotated our ingest service yesterday but didn't touch KMS. We can pause webhook delivery while you rotate.

Alex: please pause. Also we need to coordinate Vault rotation. Maya, can you run the rewrap flow and rotate Vault secrets and set short TTLs?

Maya: starting rewrap: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=wrap-staging --location=us --keyring=partners` then make new version primary. After new key version is primary, run Vault rewrap: 
``` 
# rewrap stored ciphertext using new KMS key
vault write sys/wrapping/rewrap ciphertext=@ciphertexts.json
```
I'll then rotate secrets tagged "staging-partner" with our tool: `scripts/rotate-secrets --filter=tag:staging-partner --dry-run` then actual run.

Jamal: removed partner SA decrypt binding at 1797514000. Confirmed.

Alex: patch RBAC: prevent long-lived decrypt for external SAs; create short-lived KMS access via binding automation and documented playbook SEC-2026-307.

Maya: rotation note — after rewrap, exchange wrapped blobs with partner via signed S3 presigned URLs and limit decrypt to their short-lived runtime. Also add webhook content hashing and SIEM forwarding.

security-bot: reminder: update incident checklist and apply MITRE tags. Log summary: SEC-2026-307, affected assets: KMS key partners/wrap-staging, Vault path /staging/*, partner webhook domain partner.example.com.

Alex: follow-ups: @Sally confirm webhook paused; @Jamal confirm Terraform change for KMS binding; @Maya post rotation completion ETA and runbook link.

Sally: webhook paused at 03:25Z. We're on standby.

Jamal: pushed TF change to remove partner binding in branch fix/kms-partner-rbac (#752). ETA to apply: 15m.

Maya: rotation dry-run done at 03:38Z — now running actual. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rotations/SEC-2026-307

Alex: nice. Post outcome and artifacts (audit logs, rewrap manifest). Triage notes: no plaintext leak confirmed. Closing criteria: TF applied, new key version primary, Vault secrets rotated, webhook resumed only after partner acceptance and stricter RBAC. Target close: within 2 hours.

Sally: partner ack, will resume once you confirm.

Jamal: TF applied at 03:45Z. Verified binding removed.

Maya: rotation complete at 03:52Z. Vault secrets rotated for 12 entries. Rewrap manifest uploaded to s3://sec-artifacts/SEC-2026-307/rewrap-manifest.json

Alex: marking incident in thread. Great work team. :thumbsup:

security-bot: incident SEC-2026-307 status: mitigated. Postmortem assigned to Maya; due in 7 days.
